Fixes, and lighter on the phone.

- Fixed: the tile could stay on "Searching…", animating every time the quick panel opened, if you turned on Wi-Fi in the internet panel and closed it at once. It now settles within 10 seconds, as Pixel's does.
- Fixed: the same quick close while switching to mobile data could leave the tile showing mobile data while on Wi-Fi, and the next tap brought Wi-Fi back instead of pausing it.
- Lighter: OneNet no longer listens for mobile signal strength, which it never showed, and asks the system for Wi-Fi signal levels less often.

Needs Android 17 (One UI 9) and [Shizuku](https://shizuku.rikka.app/). Installs over v0.2.
